selection_basis: Documented domain coverage, unattended APIs, repeatable artifacts, observable failures and recoverable changes. Local installation inventory did not determine these choices. Rankings are design judgments, not measured benchmarks.

providers.role: Study implementation and retain investigation evidence
providers.selected: REA with Ghidra for Windows native analysis
providers.alternatives: Direct Ghidra scripting, IDA, individual binary utilities
providers.reason: Reuses evidence and investigation operations already central to this project; native provider prerequisites must be verified separately.
Direct API and native MPQ semantics suit unattended classic Diablo II work; extracting an entry does not decode its game format.
Explicit storage/file API supports local inventory and extraction; installation variant and content revision still determine support.

providers.role: Convert WoW models and terrain with related assets
providers.alternatives: Raw CASC extraction, generic model converters
providers.reason: Retains WoW-specific model/world relationships during conversion; distributed application is GUI based and needs an automation adapter.

providers.selected: Blender Python API and background CLI
providers.reason: Broad mesh/rig/animation/material authoring with inspectable source files and unattended execution; Houdini merits a specialist provider for procedural worlds.

providers.role: Transform and compare textures, sprites and previews
providers.reason: Broad deterministic composition and image inspection; Aseprite is stronger for animation authoring, DirectXTex for DDS/BC conformance, libvips for measured high-volume workloads.
Broad unattended conversion and metadata inspection; vgmstream complements proprietary game audio and loops, GStreamer suits embedded live pipelines.

providers.role: Build and evaluate original reference projects
providers.selected: Godot headless CLI and runtime scripting
providers.reason: Headless import/run/export and inspectable project artifacts support the first production loop; this does not select the final ARPG engine.

providers.role: Inspect rendering in builds we produce
providers.reason: Programmable modern graphics inspection; legacy D3D9 is outside its API coverage, and upstream support excludes captures of programs users did not create.

providers.role: Observe and change authorized native runtime behavior
providers.reason: Structured observation, memory access, hooks and explicit detach/revert compose into agent operations; reverting hooks cannot undo prior world/save effects.
